svg.title: Narrow workshops: replace two cramped columns with one
svg.desc: At the same phone presentation, two 137-unit columns plus a 20-unit gutter become one 294-unit column. Course positions, image/button widths and image heights, text placement and inclusion line wrapping follow the changed grid. Both photos retain identical source bytes, centered crops and 2:1 frames. Words, fonts, sizes, weights, colors, course order, phone and lighting remain fixed. Original fictional static page; a separate HTML fixture demonstrates the breakpoint policy.
